nodes.label: TestForge Full Codebase Analysis
nodes.rationale: Full analysis: 8000 files, 1118981 lines, 102 endpoints, tech stack FastAPI+SQLAlchemy+Pydantic+Alembic+pytest+PostgreSQL+Uvicorn. Security: 736 findings (432 critical, 295 high) — all XSS findings in web/node_modules/object-hash (false positives, confidence=low). Unit coverage 67%, 44 test files, 214 tests. Mutation score 34%. DORA score 25. Agentic score 91. Contract score 98.

nodes.label: Claude Code Local Permissions (.claude/settings.local.json)
nodes.rationale: Project-level Claude Code permission allowlist: includes git, npm, vercel CLI, pip, python, playwright, curl, gh pr commands; also broad Read permission on user home directory

nodes.label: PRODUCT-SPEC: DClaw Migrate
nodes.rationale: Authoritative product specification: 12 domain models (Connection, MigrationJob, MigrationWave, SchemaMapping, ExecutionLog, ValidationReport, CutoverPlan, ApplicationAsset, OptimizationRec, Runbook, TestCase + dashboard), 102 API endpoints under /api/v1/, 11 UI screens, AI copilot with OpenRouter (kimi-k2) primary / Ollama (llama3) fallback, Logto JWT auth. States REVISED-PRD.md wins on features, AGENTS.md wins on architecture.

nodes.label: Docker Compose Services (postgres + backend + frontend)
nodes.rationale: Three services: postgres:16-alpine on 5432, backend on 8121 (asyncpg DATABASE_URL), frontend on 3035 (NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8121). Backend healthcheck uses python urllib (not curl — not present in slim image). Frontend healthcheck uses wget.

nodes.label: RUN.md — Operations & Deployment Guide
nodes.rationale: Covers: docker compose up --build, alembic upgrade head (4 migrations), service URLs (frontend:3035, backend:8121, docs:8121/docs), local dev (backend:8033, frontend:3033), Vercel deployment of web/ via BACKEND_URL rewrite proxy, common troubleshooting table

nodes.label: PLAN-v1.4 — Implementation Roadmap
nodes.rationale: Supersedes PLAN-v1.2. Adds mandatory Sprint 0 Engineering Hardening (H-1 CORS wildcard fix, H-2 rate limiting via slowapi, H-3 JWKS cache race, H-4 Sentry observability, H-5 auth bypass in tests, H-6 mutation score 34%→60%, H-7 PostHog analytics, H-8 N+1 audit). P0-P2 feature roadmap follows. Source of truth: REVISED-PRD.md v2.3 → AGENTS.md → PLAN-v1.4.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md — Behavioral Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Five rules: (1) Think Before Coding — surface assumptions, (2) Simplicity First — minimum code, (3) Surgical Changes — touch only what's needed, (4) Goal-Driven Execution — verifiable success criteria, (5) Source of Truth hierarchy: REVISED-PRD.md > AGENTS.md > PLAN-v1.2.md

nodes.label: AI Copilot (OpenRouter + Ollama Fallback)
nodes.rationale: Primary: OpenRouter moonshotai/kimi-k2, 60s timeout, max_tokens=2048, temperature=0.3. Fallback: Ollama llama3 via OLLAMA_BASE_URL. 8 AI endpoints: migrate-chat, suggest-mappings, assess-risk, plan-waves, assess-application, plan-cutover, cloud-strategy, containerize. Graceful degradation when no key set.

nodes.label: MigrationJob State Machine
nodes.rationale: States: draft → running (via /run) → failed (via /cancel) or completed (engine). Editing a running job returns 409. Completed job cannot be run again (edge case test required per H-6).

nodes.label: Sprint 0 Engineering Hardening (8 items)
nodes.rationale: Blocking prerequisite for external users: H-1 CORS wildcard (main.py:27, OWASP A05), H-2 rate limiting (slowapi, 20/min on high-value routes), H-3 JWKS asyncio.Lock double-checked locking, H-4 Sentry+structlog (backend) + @sentry/nextjs (frontend), H-5 explicit require_auth override in conftest, H-6 mutation kill rate 34%→60%, H-7 PostHog 5 key events, H-8 N+1 via selectinload/joinedload on list routes

nodes.label: Alembic Migration Versions (4 applied)
nodes.rationale: 4 versions: d4a2f8b3c1e7 (connections, migration_jobs), a1b2c3d4e5f6 (schema_mappings, execution_logs), b2c3d4e5f6a7 (validation_reports), c3d4e5f6a7b8 (migration_waves, application_assets, test_cases, cutover_plans, optimization_recs, runbooks)

nodes.label: TestForge Security & Quality Risk Profile
nodes.rationale: Critical risks: auth not rate-limited (agentic score 91, auth saturation = 2x load amplification), no observability (DORA MTTR=Weak), no product analytics, mutation score 34%, accessibility score 57/100. False positives: 736 security findings all in object-hash node_module (confidence=low). Supply chain score 100 (0 known-vulnerable deps).
